Google Settings.description: Newest threads per label imported when a mailbox is synced from the start.
Google Settings.label: Max Threads per Label

Google Settings.description: Days between emails reminding a user to authorize Gmail again after their authorization expires. 0 turns reminders off.
Google Settings.label: Re-authorization Reminder Interval (Days)

Google Settings.description: Email sent when a Gmail authorization expires, and as its reminders. Leave empty to use the built-in email.
Google Settings.label: Re-authorization Email Template

Google Settings.description: Optional shared secret for Pub/Sub push verification. When set, the subscription's push endpoint must be .../api/method/frappe_gmail_thread.api.pubsub.callback?token=<this value> and pushes without a matching token are rejected. Leave blank to accept pushes as before. Use Generate Token to create one and get the full URL.
Google Settings.label: PubSub Token
